entities.summary: Stefan Vojislav, a notable figure in the history of Montenegro, associated with Principality of Duklja & Zeta (1042–1186). Preceded by Kingdom of Duklja under the Vojislavljević and Slavic Settlement & Rise of Duklja. Their legacy influenced Pope Gregory VII recognises Mihailo as King of Duklja.
